channel.title: EndeavourOS News
channel.description: Release announcements from the EndeavourOS team.

item.title: Titan Nova is available
item.dc:creator: Bryanpwo
item.description: Titan Nova is an update boost on the way to Triton: Linux 7.1.8, a keyboard setup fix, better Nouveau support, and Budgie temporarily removed.

item.title: Titan Neo with some fixes and upstream updates is available
item.dc:creator: Bryanpwo
item.description: Six weeks after our Titan release, we refreshed our ISO, Titan Neo, with some fixes and minor improvements.

item.title: What’s New in EndeavourOS Titan Release?
item.dc:creator: Bryanpwo
item.description: Titan brings Linux 6.19.6, hardware detection for every GPU and VM, GPU drivers loaded early, and eos-hwtool for adding or removing them yourself.

item.title: Ganymede Neo is out with core updates and upstream NVIDIA changes
item.dc:creator: Bryanpwo
item.description: Ganymede Neo ships Linux 6.18.4 and Calamares 26.01, fixes the slow installer start, and switches the proprietary NVIDIA option to nvidia-open.

item.title: The long wait is over, Ganymede has arrived
item.dc:creator: Bryanpwo
item.description: Ganymede ships Linux 6.17.8, detects your GPU and installs nvidia or nvidia-open automatically, and only enables broadcom-wl when a device needs it.

item.title: Mercury Neo with Linux 6.13.7 and Arch mirror ranking bug fix
item.dc:creator: Bryanpwo
item.description: Mercury Neo refreshes the ISO with Linux 6.13.7, fixes the Arch mirror ranking bug that failed installs in some regions, and doubles the EFI partition to 2GB.

item.title: Our new ISO release is here, meet Mercury
item.dc:creator: Bryanpwo
item.description: Mercury arrives with Linux 6.13.1, a memory test in the EFI boot menu, dark themes by default on the larger desktops, and a fix for BIOS and legacy installs.
